description: The robot's server-to-client topics in the Message oneof of platform_shared/message.proto, by tag, with their kind. A state topic holds one current value, and the robot pushes every change of it to its subscribers. A stream topic is a sequence of frames, sent while a client subscribes. A tag not listed is no topic. The firmware's table (firmware/include/communication/topics.h, test firmware/test/test_topic_snapshot) and the app's (app/src/lib/transport/topics.ts, test app/tests/unit/topics.spec.ts) are both checked against this file.
